header: How six customers switched their stock system
lead: None of these companies was unhappy with its old system. They had grown to a size where nobody could remember what was on which shelf.

quotes.quote_text: I dreaded the changeover weekend. We opened on Monday and sold from the counter all day. The screen and the shelf never disagreed once.
quotes.author: Katrin Weissgruber

quotes.quote_text: What convinced me was keeping our own article numbers. Nobody here would learn a new number for a fitting we've sold under the same one since 1998.
quotes.author: Doris Ebner

image.alternative: Portrait of a man in his thirties.

quotes.quote_text: In the first week I checked every reorder suggestion by hand. By the third week I checked only the flagged ones. After two months I looked only at exceptions.
quotes.author: Ines Kofler

quotes.quote_text: We make to order, so software that only knows boxes on shelves is no use to us. Here an open job holds its own material and releases it if cancelled.
quotes.author: Stefan Aigner

quotes.quote_text: Before I signed anything, I asked for an export of all our data. I got it on day one, in a format I could open.
quotes.author: Hannes Wurzer

image.alternative: Portrait of a woman in her fifties.

quotes.quote_text: Our peak season lasts 11 weeks and pays for the whole year. Going into it with a working reorder list gave me my first calm autumn here.
quotes.author: Gerald Auracher
